system.description: You gain a second vice; learning a new creative hobby. What is it? When you indulge this vice by going to class, add +2 to the result, and then create a new friend or rival (classmate or teacher), or develop your relationship with an existing one. These people have no criminal utility, but they might give you a ride or let you lay low at their place in a pinch. When you overindulge, one of these friends is put in danger.
